title: DNA extraction from resin producing Boswellia tree
protocol: Collect fresh young leaf samples with lesser signs of necrosis and chlorophyll accumulation.
Ship the leaves using liquid nitrogen or ice packs at 4°C based on distance from field to lab.
Chop the leaves into smaller pieces (5mm²) removing major veins and mid-ribs with a sharp sterilized blade on ice in a glass petri-dish.
Use autoclaved distilled water (ADW; chilled at 2°C) during chopping.
Keep chopped leaves at 4°C for 3 hrs, changing ADW every hour to remove resin oozed out from leaf parts.
Maintain process in dark to consume starch inside the leaf.
Dry chopped leaves on sterilized filter paper and grind in liquid nitrogen to make a fine powder.
Notice color change from green to off-white during grinding.
Take all ground powder into 50ml falcon tube and store at -80°C for further analysis.
Autoclave buffer containing 100 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 25 mM EDTA, and 1.5 M concentration.
Store autoclaved buffer at room temperature (24°C).
Add 2.5% w/v CTAB, 1.5% PVP, 0.5% L-ascorbic acid, 0.5% BSA, and 0.5% v/v β-mercaptoethanol to pre-quantified volume of buffer.
Warm mixture to 65°C in autoclaved bottles before use.
Take one gram of frozen finely powdered leaf tissues in a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Mix with the pre-heated extraction buffer (10 ml) for one sample and vortex briefly for 30 seconds.
If grinding was not done previously, vortex the falcon tube for 5 minutes.
Place the falcon tube into a 65°C incubator or water bath and mix gently by inversion after every 10 minutes until 45 minutes total.
After incubation, allow the tube to reach room temperature for five minutes.
Centrifuge the 50 ml Falcon tube for 5 minutes at 3000×g on room temperature.
Transfer 1 ml of supernatant to each 2 ml Eppendorf tube containing 1 ml of chloroform: isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Mix the supernatant and chloroform: isoamyl alcohol by gentle inversions for 10 min.
Place the tube on ice for 10 min.
Centrifuge the tube for 10 min at 5000 × g at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase into new 2 ml tubes.
Add 5 μl RNAse A (10 mg/mL) to each tube.
Place the tubes for 30 min at 37°C.
After RNAse A treatment, add one volume of chloroform: isoamyl alcohol and mix by inversions for 5 min.
Centrifuge the tube for 10 min at 5000 × g at 4°C.
Transfer the clear supernatant into new 2 ml tubes.
Add half volume of 5 M NaCl to each sample and mix gently by inversions.
Add 2 volumes of cold 95% ethanol to each tube and mix gently by inversion.
Incubate the tubes for 45 min at -20°C freezer.
Centrifuge the tubes at 5000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Gently remove the supernatant from each tube.
Wash the pellet two times with 1 ml of 70% ethanol.
Pellet the DNA by centrifugation at 5000 × g at 4°C for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Air-dry the pellet (10 min).
Resuspend the pellet in 50 μL of TE buffer (10 mM Tris. HCl pH 8.0; 1 mM EDTA pH 8.0).
